decisions.rationale: Inert authored source-binding proposal after actual whole originalNIprinted14/PDF14 consumption table and printed15consumption explanation read. Criteria-based financial consumption consequences and credit/indebtedness risks are one economic application of the NI youth-consumption risk requirement. This does not fully cover its social and ecological risk aspects, and it is not an exact requirement for all BY household extension children. Existing source words and all historical mapping edges/decisions remain unchanged. Independent substantive source/curriculum review is still required.
